**LLMs show ability in augmenting the production of all three of its key inputs (algorithmic improvements, hardware, and data).**

LLMs are already able to write a significant proportion of the code used by frontier AI labs:

- OpenAI say o3 succeeds autonomously on 44% of OpenAI’s pull-request (PR) tasks (@openai2025o3o4systemcard).
- Anthropic say over 70% of Anthropic's PRs are “authored” by LLMs (@anthropic2025devday).
- Google say more than 25% of all the code at Google is written by AI (@google2024codeai).
